function: Provides propulsion for the robot and generates encoder feedback for odometry and speed estimation
recommended_option: JGB37-520 12V/24V DC Gear Motor with Quadrature Encoder
alternative_options: JGA25-370 DC Gear Motor with Encoder; 775 DC Gear Motor; BLDC Hub Motor
compatibility: High compatibility for a warehouse AMR prototype with payloads up to approximately 20-30 kg
software_support: Supported through ESP32 STM32 Arduino and ROS2 odometry packages
risks: Encoder quality varies by supplier; Gearbox wear under heavy loads; Torque may be insufficient if payload increases significantly
final_recommendation: Recommended for Prototype V1 due to a good balance between cost availability torque and encoder integration
